title: Alberino's aid expedition to San Antonio de Pintoyaku
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Alberino's aid expedition to San Antonio de Pintoyaku, about 2023 at San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Peruvian Amazon, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Peruvian Amazon

tellings.quote: Peru. This is the first time I was greeted by, you know, a small army of men with loaded shotguns.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes an aid trip he says he made around 2023 to San Antonio de Pintoyaku, a village in the Amazon rainforest of Peru, with companions he names as Doug Thornton, Ronnie Vernett and a man called Christian. He says it was the first time he had ever been met by what he calls a small army of men holding loaded shotguns.
